_meta.purpose: Handles that are NOT to be unpublished yet because an open decision blocks them. unpublish-collections.js reports these in their own BLOCKED section rather than silently skipping them, so a blocked row cannot quietly drop off the list.
_meta.note: Removing a handle here does not unpublish it — it only stops the block. The plan file still governs whether it is a DEINDEX/DELETE target. | "more" was removed 7 September 2026: the BBQ/outdoor category is staying, so the mega-menu item stays and the collection is a KEEP, not a block. No handles are currently blocked.
